To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) the current supply chain management system is not sufficient, b) a new supply chain system is necessary, c) the new system should have a centralized control, d) the system should be based on the Internet of Things (IoT) and e) the new system must be able to handle the complexity of supply chains.

In summary, our research is concerned with
data management for supply chain management.
the development of methods and tools for the management of complex logistic processes and the associated data.
the management of data in the supply chain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SCM is a management approach to streamline the flow of information, products, and services within a supply chain.
SCM is a process of planning, executing and controlling the supply chain in order to meet customer requirements in an efficient and cost-effective way.
the management of supply chains is a complex process that is characterized by the need for a high degree of transparency and traceability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the supply chain management is a management approach which is used to optimize the flow of goods and services.
it is necessary to develop a holistic approach that integrates all the different processes and data sources.
we developed a new concept for a supply chain management system based on a distributed data management approach using a peer-to-peer network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
supply chain transparency and traceability is an important aspect of sustainable development.
a supply chain management system is an information system that supports the planning, execution, control, and monitoring of the supply chain activities and processes.
a supply chain is a complex system and the management of the whole supply chain needs a holistic view on all process steps.
